title: Choose the new AUMINDS visual world
question: AUMINDS needs a replacement system, not another dark SaaS polish. Choose the direction for the full student and admin experience.

options.label: The Pull Request Ledger
options.lineage: code review diffs, engineering RFCs, and annotated technical notebooks
options.body: A calm, precise academy workspace built around one learning loop: study, implement, test, submit, review. Paper-white work surfaces, graphite navigation, electric chartreuse state markers, numbered lesson rails, diff-like progress, and dense typography make every screen feel like serious engineering work. The first viewport opens directly on the student's next executable task. Risk: it demands disciplined content hierarchy rather than decorative effects.

options.label: The Concourse Board
options.lineage: rail split-flap boards and operational wayfinding
options.body: A high-clarity system where courses, deadlines, reviews, and progress read like live departures. Fixed columns, strong status language, and restrained transition motion excel for admin and dashboard scanning; less natural for long-form lesson reading.

options.label: The Crew Terminal
options.body: A bold coding-first world of phosphor readouts, equipment labels, command acknowledgements, and hazard states. Highly memorable for the IDE and assessments, but more visually intense for daily long-form study.
